InsureMe Insurance Brokers PLC is pleased to present its inaugural Annual Report as a public listed entity on the
Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE). As Sri Lanka's ﬁrst listed insurance intermediary, this report reﬂects our
commitment to transparent governance, sustained value creation, and strategic innovation at the intersection of
insurance brokering and digital transformation in Sri Lanka and beyond.
This report highlights how InsureMe Group, comprising InsureMe Insurance Brokers PLC and its wholly owned
subsidiary, Digital Services Global (Pvt) Ltd (DIGIS), is transforming the insurance industry through technology-driven
convenience, innovation and transparency. Guided by our vision to “making insurance easy for everyone,” we continue
to create sustainable long-term value for our customers, shareholders, employees and the communities we serve.
As we enter our ﬁrst full year as a listed company, we remain committed to advancing our vision and creating value for

03. REPORTING BOUNDARY
This report encompasses the consolidated operations of InsureMe Insurance Brokers PLC (hereinafter referred
to as "the Company") and its wholly owned subsidiary, Digital Services Global (Pvt) Ltd (DIGIS). Together, these
entities are referred to as "the Group" throughout this report.
The Group's consolidated ﬁnancial statements include all material transactions and balances arising from the
operations of both entities. All signiﬁcant inter-company transactions have been eliminated on consolidation
in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
